lines.label: Context
lines.reviewed: Otherwise healthy outpatient, no recent abx, no urologic abnormalities. Female non-pregnant.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Duration
lines.reviewed: 3–5 days (3 d TMP-SMX, 5 d nitrofurantoin)
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Notes
lines.reviewed: Confirm uncomplicated criteria. For pregnant, complicated, or pyelo cases, see Complicated UTI / Pyelonephritis.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Nitrofurantoin (urinary isolates)
lines.reviewed: 100 mg PO BID × 5 d | Local E. coli susceptibility ~97%. Excellent urinary concentration.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: TMP-SMX (Bactrim)
lines.reviewed: 1 DS PO BID × 3 d | Local E. coli susceptibility ~75%. Avoid if local resistance > 20% or recent TMP-SMX use.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Cefazolin (urinary isolates)
lines.reviewed: Cephalexin 500 mg PO QID × 5–7 d | Cephalexin reasonable second-line, especially for ESBL concerns are low.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Ciprofloxacin
lines.reviewed: Reserve fluoroquinolones — local E. coli FQ susceptibility ~70–75%; ADRs (tendon, QT, neurologic).
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Ampicillin
lines.reviewed: Local E. coli susceptibility ~52% — inadequate empiric coverage.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Context
lines.reviewed: Pyelonephritis, urosepsis, indwelling catheter, male, pregnant, or urologic abnormalities.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Duration
lines.reviewed: 5–7 days (depending on agent — see Shorter Is Better)
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Notes
lines.reviewed: If patient has had recent abx, ESBL history, or healthcare exposure — consider cefepime or carbapenem and consult ID.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Ceftriaxone
lines.reviewed: 1–2 g IV q24h | Local gram-negative susceptibility ~81–92%. First-line empiric for inpatient pyelo.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Piperacillin/tazobactam
lines.reviewed: 3.375–4.5 g IV q6–8h | If sepsis, recent broad-spectrum abx, or healthcare exposure. Avoid for HECK-Yes organisms.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Cefepime
lines.reviewed: 1–2 g IV q8–12h | If Pseudomonas risk or AmpC concern.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Ampicillin/sulbactam
lines.reviewed: Local E. coli susceptibility ~63–65% — borderline coverage for empiric.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Nitrofurantoin (urinary isolates)
lines.reviewed: Does NOT achieve adequate tissue levels — urinary tract concentration only. Don't use for pyelo.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Context
lines.reviewed: Outpatient or inpatient (non-ICU) without risk factors for MRSA or Pseudomonas.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Duration
lines.reviewed: 3–5 days (if afebrile and clinically improving)
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Notes
lines.reviewed: Per IDSA 2019. Add vancomycin OR linezolid for MRSA risk; add piperacillin-tazobactam OR cefepime for Pseudomonas risk.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Ceftriaxone
lines.reviewed: 1–2 g IV q24h + macrolide or doxycycline | Inpatient non-ICU. Covers S. pneumoniae, H. influenzae, Moraxella.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Levofloxacin
lines.reviewed: 750 mg IV/PO q24h | Respiratory fluoroquinolone monotherapy. Use when beta-lactam contraindicated.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Vancomycin
lines.reviewed: Not needed empirically unless MRSA risk factors (recent hospitalization, prior MRSA, severe CAP).
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Context
lines.reviewed: Pneumonia developing ≥ 48 h after admission or ≥ 48 h after intubation.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Duration
lines.reviewed: 5–7 days (depending on pathogen)
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Notes
lines.reviewed: Per IDSA 2016. De-escalate based on culture data. Add linezolid alternative if vancomycin contraindicated.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Cefepime
lines.reviewed: 2 g IV q8h + vancomycin 15–20 mg/kg IV q8–12h | Empiric coverage of Pseudomonas + MRSA. Local Pseudomonas cefepime susceptibility ~93–94%.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Piperacillin/tazobactam
lines.reviewed: 4.5 g IV q6h (extended infusion) + vancomycin | If no AmpC concern. ICU Pseudomonas pip-tazo ~92%.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Meropenem
lines.reviewed: 1 g IV q8h + vancomycin | If ESBL or carbapenem-needed pathogens suspected.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Ceftriaxone
lines.reviewed: No Pseudomonas coverage — inadequate empiric for HAP/VAP.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Context
lines.reviewed: Non-purulent cellulitis vs purulent (abscess/furuncle). Severity determines coverage.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Duration
lines.reviewed: 5–7 days (non-purulent cellulitis 5 d)
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Notes
lines.reviewed: Per IDSA 2014. Source control (I&D) is the primary treatment for abscess.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Cefazolin (urinary isolates)
lines.reviewed: Cephalexin 500 mg PO QID (mild) or cefazolin 1–2 g IV q8h (mod) | Non-purulent cellulitis: targets Streptococcus. Local MSSA cefazolin ~100% (via oxacillin).
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: TMP-SMX (Bactrim)
lines.reviewed: 1–2 DS PO BID | Purulent / suspected MRSA. Local MRSA TMP-SMX ~65–73%.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Clindamycin
lines.reviewed: 300–450 mg PO TID or 600 mg IV q8h | Beta-lactam allergy. Local MRSA clindamycin ~69–91% — variable, check sensitivities.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Vancomycin
lines.reviewed: 15–20 mg/kg IV q8–12h | Severe / inpatient MRSA-suspected. Local MRSA 100%.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Linezolid
lines.reviewed: 600 mg IV/PO q12h | PO option for MRSA outpatient bridge.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Ciprofloxacin
lines.reviewed: Poor Strep coverage and overuse driving resistance.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Context
lines.reviewed: Community-acquired complicated IAI (perforated appendix, diverticulitis, secondary peritonitis).
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Duration
lines.reviewed: 4 days post source control (STOP-IT trial)
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Notes
lines.reviewed: Source control (drainage, surgery) is essential. Per IDSA/SIS. Add Enterococcus coverage (ampicillin) for severe / immunocompromised.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Ceftriaxone
lines.reviewed: 1–2 g IV q24h + metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h | Covers gram-negatives + anaerobes. Standard for community-acquired moderate severity.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Piperacillin/tazobactam
lines.reviewed: 3.375–4.5 g IV q6–8h | Single-agent for severe/healthcare-associated. Covers Pseudomonas + anaerobes.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Ampicillin/sulbactam
lines.reviewed: 3 g IV q6h | If pip-tazo unavailable. Note Enterococcus coverage added by ampicillin.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.

lines.label: Ciprofloxacin
lines.reviewed: Insufficient gram-negative coverage as monotherapy locally.
lines.note: Confirmed by the MU pharmacy team, per Thiago 2026-11-24.
